notes: A page that needs the license key now shows the key page, instead of "The page could not be drawn".
The program holds its address alone: another program on the same port can no longer answer in its place. The new installer also moves to a free port when 8791 is taken.

GoldDesk, the addon WoWForDesk grew from, is turned off for every character (it stayed on where the AddOns list did not name it, and both ran side by side).
The installer's window has no scroll bar.
